must infer them. A selected candidate whose band gap is below the threshold
scores zero.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".

turns.answer_text:
I combined composition and structure descriptors with grouped cross-validation, then checked the leading predictions against chemically and structurally matched training examples.

| Rank | Candidate | Formula | Structural reasoning | Estimated gap | Estimated SHG |
|---:|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | `c052` | Zn₂Ga₄S₈ | `I-42m`; close to transparent Zn₄Ge₂S₈ (3.231 eV, 18.849 pm/V) | 3.2–3.4 eV | 17–21 pm/V |
| 2 | `c051` | Zn₂Ga₄S₈ | `I-4`; matches Cd₂Ga₄S₈ (2.864 eV, 21.700 pm/V), with Zn-for-Cd expected to raise the gap | 3.1–3.4 eV | 16–20 pm/V |
| 3 | `c050` | ZnGa₂S₄ | `P-42m`; same favorable tetrahedral Zn-Ga-S bonding in another polymorph | 3.1–3.5 eV | 13–18 pm/V |
| 4 | `c081` | Al₄Zn₄S₁₀ | Polar `P2₁` Al/Zn sulfide, bracketed by transparent Al-Cd-S, Zn-Ge-S, and ZnS examples | 3.3–3.8 eV | 10–15 pm/V |
| 5 | `c037` | Be₄Se₄ | Zincblende `F-43m`; Be widens the gap substantially relative to ZnSe while retaining a useful tetrahedral response | 3.3–4.2 eV | 8–14 pm/V |

I excluded the potentially stronger LiAsS₂ and Ga₂S₃ candidates because their connected lone-pair or Ga-S band-edge chemistry leaves a substantial risk of falling below 3 eV.

Final: c052, c051, c050, c081, c037
